name: bare-module-traverse
description: Low-level module graph traversal for Bare

exports.name: traverse
signatures: traverse(entry: URL, readModule: (url: URL) => Buffer | string | null, listPrefix?: (url: URL) => Iterable<URL>, probeModule?: (url: URL) => boolean | undefined, resolveModule?: (url: URL) => URL): Iterable<Dependency>

traverse(entry: URL, readModule: (url: URL) => Promise<Buffer | string | null>, listPrefix?: (url: URL) => AsyncIterable<URL>, probeModule?: (url: URL) => Promise<boolean | undefined>, resolveModule?: (url: URL) => Promise<URL>): AsyncIterable<Dependency>

traverse(entry: URL, opts: TraverseOptions, readModule: (url: URL) => Buffer | string | null, listPrefix?: (url: URL) => Iterable<URL>, probeModule?: (url: URL) => boolean | undefined, resolveModule?: (url: URL) => URL): Iterable<Dependency>

traverse(entry: URL, opts: TraverseOptions, readModule: (url: URL) => Promise<Buffer | string | null>, listPrefix?: (url: URL) => AsyncIterable<URL>, probeModule?: (url: URL) => Promise<boolean | undefined>, resolveModule?: (url: URL) => Promise<URL>): AsyncIterable<Dependency>
exports.description: Traverse the module graph rooted at `entry`, which must be a WHATWG `URL` instance. `readModule` is called with a `URL` instance for every module to be read and must either return the module source, if it exists, or `null`. `listPrefix` is called with a `URL` instance of every prefix to be listed and must yield `URL` instances that have the specified `URL` as a prefix. If not provided, prefixes won't be traversed. If `readModule` returns a promise or `listPrefix` returns a promise generator, synchronous iteration is not supported.

params.name: entry
params.description: The WHATWG `URL` of the entry module to root the graph at.

params.name: readModule
params.description: Called with the `URL` of each module to read; returns its source as a `Buffer` or `string`, or `null` if it does not exist. Returning a promise disables synchronous iteration.

params.name: listPrefix
params.description: Called with the `URL` of each prefix to list; must yield the `URL`s that have it as a prefix. If omitted, prefixes are not traversed.

params.name: probeModule
params.description: Called with the `URL` of each module to probe for existence; returns a boolean, or `undefined` to fall back to `readModule`.

params.name: resolveModule
params.description: Called with each resolution `URL` to transform; returns the `URL` to use in its place. Defaults to the identity function.

returns.description: An iterable of resolved `Dependency` records for the module graph; asynchronous when any callback returns a promise.
